text:
maya: FYI opened a tiny hotfix PR to docs to add the Statuspage link + a short known-issues/workaround for the auth outage earlier. need a 2nd reviewer and a quick CI/docs-preview check before merge. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412

alex: on it. can you paste the exact statuspage URL you want in the notice?

maya: using https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-auth-outage-3 — adding to /docs/known-issues.md and a short callout at /docs/operational/incident-response.md

sam: quick question about the workaround snippet: you used the legacy SDK snippet, should we include the new python async example instead?

maya: good catch — updated PR with both: a short paragraph + code block for sync (legacy) and async (recommended).

alex: CI preview failing on the preview build, looks like an MD lint error on the new snippet (backticks mismatch). pushing a small fix. :wrench:

irene: added as reviewer, can approve once CI is green. tagging @nick for product eyes on wording for customer-facing line.

nick: skimmed — wording is fine, tiny nit: change "we are aware" to "we identified" to be more precise. otherwise approve.

maya: applied wording nit, pushed. preview now generates but the statuspage link isn't rendering as expected in the callout box — I think the callout macro needs a raw link instead of markdown.

sam: try this in the callout: 

> [Statuspage — Incident 2026: Auth outage](https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-auth-outage-3)

and for the workaround block include:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="<REDACTED>")
# short workaround: retry with backoff on 401s while we rotate auth cache
```

maya: updated to raw link + added the python snippet from the PR. CI preview shows the callout properly now.

dev-deploy-bot: docs-preview: build succeeded (preview URL: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr-412)

irene: approving now. go ahead and merge after you confirm the final preview link in the PR description. :+1:

maya: merged and backported to stable branch. posting quick follow-up to customers on the status page link and the workaround in the incident postmortem. thanks all! :heart:

alex: nice — can we add a short entry to the internal changelog for the docs hotfix so support can reference it?

maya: added to /internal/changelog.md with PR #412 and the preview URL. support pinged.

sam: great, closing loop. if anything else pops up on formatting i'll open a follow-up PR.

maya: closing thread.
